scope: INDEPENDENT CPU counterexample audit of the Task B delivery contract. No GPU, no production file modified, no threshold relaxed, no failure reclassified.
source_sha256_note: the production tree was being edited by another writer while this audit ran, so every result below belongs to exactly these revisions and no other
note_on_the_seam: the production PayloadRaisePrefix is exercised directly at its A-arrival branch; the parent carry machine is exercised through a counting stub child that returns that REAL carry record, because the true prefix needs the GPU simulator

checks.contract_ref: plan 3 "A 到位交接" / "不调用 tracker.begin(B)"
checks.claim_under_test: the handoff publishes once and NEVER begins the swing
checks.method: drive the real PayloadRaisePrefix._advance_segment("A") 5x at the A branch
checks.trivial_pass_risk: none: the counter is read before and after, and goal B is compared by value

checks.contract_ref: plan 3 "正在使用的同一个 PayloadJointTracker 实例"
checks.claim_under_test: the handoff carries the SAME tracker instance, not a copy
checks.method: identity comparison carry["tracker"] is prefix.tracker on the real class

checks.contract_ref: plan 3 "Once published" the transfer is single-shot
checks.claim_under_test: the carry state can be taken exactly once
checks.method: call take_carry_state() a second time on the real class

observed.second_call: ValueError: the carry state has already been taken

checks.contract_ref: plan 3 "顶层从下一 tick 起永久停止调用前缀子策略"
checks.claim_under_test: the prefix child is called once per tick while it runs and NEVER after
checks.method: counting stub child through the production _prefix path, then 10 more ticks
checks.trivial_pass_risk: the child is a stub; only the parent prefix path is under test here
checks.note: the stub child is not the frozen prefix; the prefix itself is tested above

checks.contract_ref: plan 3 "移动阶段必须 wheel_hold_requested=False，否则 evaluator 会覆盖所有导航请求"
checks.claim_under_test: no movement phase holds the wheel anchor, so the navigation slice survives
checks.method: run into PROBE_DRIVE, emit the real action, then replay the evaluator composition
checks.trivial_pass_risk: guarded: part (a) proves the overwrite really happens when held, and part (b) requires the emitted request to be non-zero, so a zero request cannot pass this check
checks.note: the drive layer is the delivered task_b.carry_drive

checks.contract_ref: plan 3 "开始减速时保持 False ... 开始下一次真实移动才 release"
checks.claim_under_test: entering any declared movement phase releases the anchor
checks.method: _begin() every phase in MOVEMENT_PHASES and read wheel_hold_requested
checks.trivial_pass_risk: these are the phases the implementation itself declares as movement; a phase it failed to declare would not be covered here

checks.contract_ref: plan 3 "不要在仍以 .235 m/s 滑行时重置 .03 m 静止预算"
checks.claim_under_test: a NEW wheel anchor is taken only after the base has stopped
checks.method: hold the brake phase at 7 constant planar speeds for 150 ticks each
checks.trivial_pass_risk: guarded: the battery also requires an anchor to be reachable at all (see anchor-reengage), so a policy that simply never anchors cannot pass by accident
checks.note: the speeds below the .01 m/s settle gate must anchor; the sweep reports which did

checks.contract_ref: plan 4 "公开速度已足够低后才切 True" + "期望/实测 yaw 上限 .08 rad/s"
checks.claim_under_test: the anchor is not taken while the base is still YAWING
checks.method: hold the brake phase at zero planar speed with 7 constant yaw rates, 150 ticks each
checks.trivial_pass_risk: guarded: the same series contains a yaw of 0 that must anchor
checks.note: the anchor gate reuses the .12 rad/s quiet angular gate, which is wider than the .08 rad/s probe yaw cap; the sweep measures whether that width is reachable

checks.contract_ref: plan 3 "静止段反复 engage 不重抓锚"
checks.claim_under_test: a settled stationary stretch does not re-take the anchor
checks.method: stay settled in the brake phase for 150 further ticks after the anchor was taken
checks.trivial_pass_risk: the battery requires at least one engage, so "never anchors" cannot pass

checks.contract_ref: plan 4 "原 hold_quiet_calls * dt 不能代替端点持续时间"
checks.claim_under_test: the hold duration is NOT the length of a bounded window
checks.method: drive _quiet_tick for 200 ticks on a still arm and read quiet_elapsed_s()
checks.trivial_pass_risk: none: a window-length implementation would pin this at 0.5 s

checks.contract_ref: plan 4 "只有完整静稳窗口 quiet_ready 成立才累计，任何失静/暂停清零"
checks.claim_under_test: losing quiet zeroes the hold run
checks.method: accumulate 80 quiet ticks, then 3 ticks at 0.05 m/s, then read the timer

checks.contract_ref: plan 4 "任何失静/暂停清零"
checks.claim_under_test: a stance pause also zeroes the hold run
checks.method: accumulate 80 quiet ticks, raise pause_for_stance, run 5 further ticks
checks.trivial_pass_risk: none: the flag is set on the live policy object
checks.note: the carry state machine never reads pause_for_stance; measured, not inferred

checks.contract_ref: plan 4 "不能仅用 quiet_tick 绕过 .002 rad 位置窗口"
checks.claim_under_test: a quiet velocity signal cannot bypass the .002 rad position window
checks.method: walk one arm axis at 5e-4 rad/tick with reported qdot exactly zero
checks.trivial_pass_risk: none: the check fails if quiet_ready is reachable while walking

checks.contract_ref: plan 4 "保留实际 goal_error<.04 rad、完整 .5 s（26 样本）窗口与 arm span <=.002 rad"
checks.claim_under_test: the carry-ready stationary gate keeps goal_error < .04 rad
checks.method: hold a perfectly still arm 0.06 rad AWAY from the fixed A goal and watch the phase
checks.trivial_pass_risk: none: the arm is still, so the window and span gates pass; only the goal-error element can hold the phase
checks.note: the debug record prints goal_error_rad next to goal_error_limit_rad, but nothing in the carry state machine compares them

checks.contract_ref: plan 4 "张指到位后观察端点计时" + plan 7 "连续观察至少真实 3.0 秒"
checks.claim_under_test: the observation ends on a REAL elapsed hold, longer than the window
checks.method: drive the production phase machine through the whole carry probe on the audit twist model
checks.note: the carry-probe observation is 1.0 s here; the 3.0 s figure belongs to the release stage, which does not exist yet

checks.contract_ref: plan 4 "任何失静/暂停清零"
checks.claim_under_test: a pause during the observation does not let it complete
checks.method: reach PROBE_HOLD, then assert pause_for_stance for the whole observation
checks.trivial_pass_risk: none: the pause flag is set on the live policy object
checks.note: the carry state machine never reads pause_for_stance after the handoff

checks.contract_ref: plan 3 "That is an implementation fault, so stop rather than carry on"
checks.claim_under_test: an incomplete handoff is stopped, not crashed
checks.method: stub a prefix that reports handoff_ready but whose state is incomplete

observed.outcome: ValueError: zero-dimensional arrays cannot be concatenated
observed.done_reason: delivery_handoff_incomplete: the carry state is incomplete; the prefix never fully opened

checks.note: the intended delivery_handoff_incomplete stop path builds an action from a template that does not exist yet

checks.contract_ref: plan 3 "顶层对外仍提供 act(proprio, images) ... 使 evaluator 不必重写记录器"
checks.claim_under_test: a closed episode can still be asked for its closing action
checks.method: stop the prefix before any handoff, then call act() once more

observed.second_act_outcome: ValueError: zero-dimensional arrays cannot be concatenated

checks.note: the production evaluator breaks out of its loop on the same tick, so this is latent; any other driver that wants one closing action hits it

checks.contract_ref: plan 3 "a missing or broken drive layer must show up as an explicit diagnostic"
checks.claim_under_test: a missing drive layer stops the run with an explicit drive diagnostic
checks.method: monkeypatch _drive_layer to return None and drive a movement phase

drive_state_recorded.reason: no usable drive layer (task_b.carry_drive is missing or failed to build); the base cannot be commanded to move

checks.trivial_pass_risk: none: the branch is forced directly
checks.note: the unavailable drive is reported inside debug["wheel"]["drive"] but the STOP reason comes from the stall watchdog

checks.contract_ref: plan 4 P0 "移动预算与静止预算分离" + plan 3 "不要套用 .03 m/.05 rad 位移/yaw 预算"
checks.claim_under_test: the loaded move is bounded by the PROBE budget, not by the .03 m stationary budget
checks.method: drive PROBE_DRIVE to its own distance target and measure how far the base actually went
checks.trivial_pass_risk: none: a wrapper that kept the stationary budget would stop before the target and never reach the brake phase

checks.contract_ref: plan 4 P0 "NaN/丢帧/无进展正常停止"
checks.claim_under_test: NaN / wrong-length / over-tilt proprio stop normally instead of crashing
checks.method: feed three malformed proprio vectors to the production act()
checks.trivial_pass_risk: none: each case requires BOTH a returned action and a named stop reason

checks.contract_ref: plan 7 "RELEASE_OPEN 进入条件: D 实际到位、完整新鲜静止窗口成立、轮锚保持..."
checks.claim_under_test: the release/open stage is unreachable before the arrival gates
checks.method: enumerate the declared phases and drive both modes to their stop
checks.trivial_pass_risk: THIS CHECK IS VACUOUS TODAY: the release/open stage does not exist in the delivered module, so there is no gate to test and no failure to reclassify. The battery can only become real once the stage exists.
checks.note: a failed open cannot be reclassified as a release because there is no open and no release; the delivery chain has not been implemented yet

checks.contract_ref: plan 3 ownership table + plan 7 "不向策略注入 GT/root/contact/reward/seed 地图"
checks.claim_under_test: no GT, world base pose, contact force, reward, score or seed map reaches the policy
checks.method: AST scan of delivery.py/carry_drive.py/bucket_observation.py for contract-derived names
checks.trivial_pass_risk: an identifier scan can only catch literal names; it cannot prove that a value is not smuggled in through a differently named variable. It is a necessary, not a sufficient, check.

checks.contract_ref: plan 3 "所有策略模块仍只有 public inputs"
checks.claim_under_test: the policy entry point accepts only public proprio and RGB-D
checks.method: inspect the production act() signature and run a carry sequence CPU-only
checks.trivial_pass_risk: a signature check cannot see what act() does with the values; the AST scan above is the companion check

checks.contract_ref: plan 4 P0 "CPU 覆盖加载→输出夹限→卸载" + signal review 5.3 "未反馈最终 slew/tether/hard-limit 的夹限"
checks.claim_under_test: a final-command clamp must stop the integral from ramping
checks.method: feed-forward 0.15 rad on one axis with a 5e-2 tracking error inside the P cap; recompute candidate-command every tick
checks.trivial_pass_risk: guarded: the battery requires both a clamped row and a non-zero integral before it can falsify
checks.note: the code's own "unsaturated" test only compares the P term with its cap, so it reports unsaturated while the applied command is slew/tether clamped

checks.contract_ref: plan 4 P0 "积分在最终命令限幅时仍可能积分"
checks.claim_under_test: a HARD joint-limit clamp must stop the integral from ramping
checks.method: place the reference on arm_joint3's upper static limit with a 5e-2 error inside the P cap

checks.contract_ref: plan 7 "卸载时积分只作抗 windup 和既有有界反馈，不能把 arm_command 一次性跳回无载参考"
checks.claim_under_test: after unloading, the wound-up trim must not bias the command past its reference
checks.method: unload a tracker that wound up against a hard limit, then move its goal clear of the limit
checks.trivial_pass_risk: guarded: the battery fails only if the un-rewound trim actually holds the command away from the reference
checks.note: the command is slew-bounded (no jump), which the design does achieve; the hazard is the stored trim, which never leaks and therefore holds a permanent steady-state offset
